business_problem: MissionWired needed a better way to support donor prospecting, campaign targeting, and fundraising optimization because legacy systems could not process massive donor datasets quickly enough to outperform declining acquisition channels or keep campaign costs under control.
solution_summary: MissionWired uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support donor prospecting, campaign targeting, and fundraising optimization. The implementation replaced a legacy state where legacy systems could not process massive donor datasets quickly enough to outperform declining acquisition channels or keep campaign costs under control. Donor events and email engagement data move through Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL and Serverless compute operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver prospect scores and segmented outreach lists.
business_outcome: MissionWired improved donor prospecting, campaign targeting, and fundraising optimization with measurable results including 275B connecting supporters with causes to drive meaningful change, $350M donor data points processed, and 125M+, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
